task: Repeated edits of authored synthetic SVG motifs with known program graphs
protocol: Same valid initial SVG and request order for every method. Fail-stop after a failed feasible request; skipped later requests remain visible. Only checked outputs become subsequent state. Final impossible request is expected to be rejected.
limitations: Small authored programs, not independently annotated external figures
Reuse and fresh recovery use the same layout engine; a tie does not demonstrate a reuse advantage
ELK receives the same recovered graph and fitted text but optimizes a different layout objective
Direct attributes is a simple fixed-geometry baseline, not a modern AI editor
ELK repair uses the same MILP engine; it is a hybrid baseline, not an independent solver
Topological strip shares the visibility router and text metrics; motifs can be easy for this baseline
Edge-edge crossings and actual browser typography are outside this benchmark
